text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A recommendation to the electoral commission by a group of politicians to register just six parties for the military government's transition to democracy has been rejected.
- Local council elections which were due to take place in the last quarter of 1996 may now be postponed until May 1997.
- A reshuffle of government ministers may not be part of head of state General Sani Abacha's Independence day broadcast on Tuesday.
